items.name: metric-picker
items.title: Metric picker
items.description: Controlled metric selection over supplied grouped options, with local search.
items.docs: Controlled metric-picker primitive. Import the installed finstack theme. Supply canonical values, labels, constraints and option lists; this item owns presentation only. No worker or workbench is required.

items.name: measure-value
items.title: Measure value
items.description: Displays one supplied measure with its source-backed unit; missing values never become zero.
items.docs: Controlled measure-value primitive. Import the installed finstack theme. Supply canonical values, labels, constraints and option lists; this item owns presentation only. No worker or workbench is required.

items.name: stamp-badge
items.title: Stamp badge
items.description: Displays the calculation stamps returned with a result: numeric mode, rounding, FX policy and version.
items.docs: Controlled stamp-badge primitive. Import the installed finstack theme. Supply canonical values, labels, constraints and option lists; this item owns presentation only. No worker or workbench is required.

items.name: valuation-summary
items.title: Valuation summary
items.description: Headline value, instrument ID, as-of date and calculation stamps of a supplied valuation result, with optional comparison.
items.docs: Displays supplied valuation context and raw measures. Comparisons retain independent currencies and stamps; no local differences, aggregates or FX conversion. Pass native metric groups and explicit source-backed units when available.

items.name: measures-grid
items.title: Measures grid
items.description: Table of a valuation result's measures with native labels, grouped bucket tenors and exact values, with optional comparison.
items.docs: Displays supplied valuation context and measures. Labels are the native metric id in sentence case with recognised acronyms upper-cased; native metric metadata groups bucket tenors in maturity order; Exact keys reveals fully qualified keys. Values default to six significant digits, with Exact values and value titles retaining supplied precision. The nonzero view hides zero rows only when both sides are supplied and zero in a comparison; Show all reveals every row, and missing values remain distinct. Comparisons retain independent currencies, dates and stamps; no local differences, aggregates or FX conversion. Pass native metric metadata and explicit source-backed units when available.

items.name: dimensional-measures
items.title: Dimensional measures
items.description: Per-coordinate measures as bucket lists, two-axis matrices and three-axis slices, driven by native metric metadata.
items.docs: Displays native per-coordinate valuation measures as bucket lists, two-axis matrices, and selectable three-axis slices. Uses Rust-supplied metric metadata for coordinates and units; exact values and canonical keys remain available.

items.name: instrument-form
items.title: Instrument form
items.description: All-instrument form with grouped search, examples and lazily loaded schema modules; native validation is supplied by the caller.
items.docs: Standalone all-instrument generated form with grouped search, explicit examples and guarded recent selections. Lazy schema modules are reused by native module caching. Native validation is supplied by the consumer.

items.name: pricing-params-form
items.title: Pricing parameters form
items.description: Controlled pricing parameters: model, metrics, metric pricing overrides and market history.
items.docs: Standalone controlled pricing parameters. Supply native groups from useModels and useMetrics(instrumentType). Selected metrics the type does not offer are reported, never dropped. Metric pricing overrides are edited from their schema and emitted as compact JSON. Market history text and omitted versus empty metric selection are preserved. JSON validation checks syntax only; native pricing owns financial validation.

items.name: cashflow-viewer
items.title: Cashflow viewer
items.description: Table of a supplied native cashflow envelope with row-currency amounts, reporting-currency PV, an optional native annual ladder per row currency and a JSON export.
items.docs: Table of the supplied native cashflow envelope object with row-currency amounts and reporting-currency PV, validated against the Rust schema. Rust supplies totals and reconciliation. An optional ladder prop (the native cashflows.calendarYearLadder rows per row currency, as useCashflowLadder returns them) adds a Schedule / Annual ladder toggle with one table per currency in native PV. Envelope JSON (a host serialization of the object) is available for copy/download. Accepts cashflows, ladder, loading and error props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: explanation-trace
items.title: Explanation trace
items.description: Lossless disclosure of a valuation result's optional explanation payload.
items.docs: Optional original valuation explanation rendered losslessly; no steps or severity are inferred.

items.name: valuation-details
items.title: Valuation details
items.description: Routes a result's detail payload to its view: Monte Carlo diagnostics, explanation, covenants or raw JSON.
items.docs: Lazy native result detail routing. Only Monte Carlo has a complete published host shape; composite, credit, FX and structured-credit payloads stay raw. Unknown tags show a warning; full result metadata and nullable fields remain available.

items.name: scenario-heatmap
items.title: Scenario heatmap
items.description: Heatmap of a structured-credit scenario table: clean price by CPR and CDR at a controlled severity.
items.docs: Display returned ScenarioTable prices at original CPR/CDR coordinates, with an explicitly controlled severity and priceDomain straddling the canonical par reference 100. Prices are clean settlement percentages of current tranche balance per Rust ScenarioCell.price. Optional shared linking, callbacks, tooltip body, annotations and complete figure exports. No valuation, rebasing or WAL/writedown overlay.

items.name: tranche-analytics
items.title: Tranche analytics
items.description: Displays one structured-credit tranche's native metrics, break-even CDR, discount margin and OAS, each with its own native error.
items.docs: Present native valuations.instruments results for one tranche as supplied: the TrancheMetrics fields in Rust declaration order (unset optional fields hidden) with the unit each Rust field documents, any requested registry metrics raw, trancheBreakevenCdr and trancheDiscountMargin as decimals, and the trancheOas result. The clean price is a controlled exact-decimal input, percent of current balance; no price is assumed, and discount margin and OAS stay idle without one. OAS runs only through onSolveOas. With onOasConfigChange, an OAS configuration disclosure edits the generated OasConfig contract, starting from its Rust example (OasConfig::default()), and hands complete JSON to the host on apply. Nothing is computed, rescaled or defaulted. No worker is required.

items.name: pricing-workbench
items.title: Pricing workbench
items.description: All-instrument pricing workbench: market browser and editor, calibration, valuation results, cashflows, tranche analytics and scenarios.
items.docs: All-instrument workbench with complete market browser/editor, explicitly configured evaluated views, native calibration/diagnostics, linked residuals, validated market-to-pricing handoff and optional structured-credit tranche analytics (with an applied OasConfig) and scenarios over an editable ScenarioGrid seeded from the host grid. Host owns routes and domain inputs.

items.name: use-price-instrument
items.title: usePriceInstrument
items.description: Prices an instrument through the WASM worker; also exposes model, metric, metric-metadata and money-format queries.
items.docs: Browser-only shared worker and complete immutable queries. Wrap with FinstackQueryProvider, or FinstackProvider inside an existing QueryClientProvider. Worker and hooks follow the consumer source directory; the consumer owns its standard @/* source alias. Keep the matching local WASM package installed.

items.name: use-instrument-validator
items.title: useInstrumentValidator
items.description: Validates and canonicalizes instrument JSON through the WASM worker, for schema-form.
items.docs: Native SchemaForm validation using the existing FinstackProvider worker. Returns canonical JSON and rejects superseded revisions; does not write canonical output into active edits.

items.name: use-cashflows
items.title: useCashflows
items.description: Fetches the native cashflow envelope for a pricing request through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native cashflow envelope object with complete immutable request/session keys and native errors. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider. No cashflow rows or financial logic are inferred.

items.name: use-cashflow-ladder
items.title: useCashflowLadder
items.description: Fetches the native calendar-year cashflow ladder of a supplied cashflow envelope, one per row currency, through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native cashflows.calendarYearLadder rows for each row currency of the supplied envelope, in first-appearance order, over each flow's native PV (row currency, before FX conversion and any scenario price shock). Keyed on the complete envelope and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider. No sums or FX conversion are computed locally.

items.name: use-scenario-table
items.title: useScenarioTable
items.description: Fetches a native structured-credit tranche scenario table through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native structured-credit scenario table with immutable complete request/session keys. No locally computed prices.

items.name: use-tranche-analytics
items.title: useTrancheAnalytics
items.description: Fetches native structured-credit tranche metrics, OAS, discount margin and break-even CDR through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Four query option builders and hooks over valuations.instruments.trancheMetrics, trancheOas, trancheDiscountMargin and trancheBreakevenCdr, each keyed by its complete immutable request and the worker session; null disables a call. An omitted metrics price or metric list is left to Rust; OAS and discount margin require an explicit clean price, and OAS uses Rust's default OasConfig. Native errors are returned unchanged.

items.name: pricing-forms-example
items.title: Pricing forms example
items.description: Example: instrument and pricing forms wired to the validator and pricing hooks, without the workbench.
items.docs: Standalone instrument and pricing forms with caller state and real shared worker hooks. Example installs at the consumer source directory under examples/ and receives the consumer-owned components alias. Fixture request derives from manifest-listed native instrument/market fixtures. No workbench block is imported.
